SYNTHETIC FACILITIES SUBSCRIPTION
Quarry Systems supplies room-booking software to Vale Labs. The agreement rolls over into another annual term unless Vale delivers notice of non-renewal at least sixty-one days before expiry. Invoices are settled within ten days.

expected_evidence.P3: The agreement rolls over into another annual term unless Vale delivers notice of non-renewal at least sixty-one days before expiry.

Deliverables consist of drawings and a design review.

cases.source:
SYNTHETIC LICENSE SCHEDULE
Moss licenses reporting tools from Flint.
Term: 12 months. Automatic renewal: yearly.
Non-renewal: either party must provide written notice at least 59 days before renewal.
Payment: 120 days from invoice.
Delivery: 90 days from order.
This schedule contains no other allocation of liability or obligations following termination.

SYNTHETIC AGREEMENT: SILVER / FIELD
Field supplies Silver with laboratory scheduling tools. Annual fees are EUR 18,000.
Risk allocation. Aggregate liability for either party is limited to fees paid in the preceding twelve months. Indirect and consequential damages are excluded.
Third-party claims. Each party indemnifies the other for claims arising from its own negligence, wilful misconduct or breach of this agreement.
Duration. The subscription renews annually unless either party gives forty-five days' written notice before renewal.
Exit. Field may end the service for convenience on sixty days' written notice and will refund all unused prepaid fees.
Files. Field must erase customer files within fourteen days after termination and provide advance notice of any new subprocessor.
